item.title: LeafSkill: Efficient Leaf-Level Action Grounding for Recursive LLM Agents
item.description: Recursive large language model (LLM) agents solve long-horizon tasks through decomposition, execution, and environmental feedback. Yet after producing an atomic subtask, they often invoke the same large model again to translate a familiar instruction into an executable action.

item.title: Async-RBench: Benchmarking Asynchronous Task Execution in LLM Agents
item.description: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes.

item.title: Tampered ML: Evaluating LLM Judgment of Machine Learning Research
item.description: One approach to accelerating progress on AI alignment is to automate parts of alignment research itself. Doing so requires systems that can perform reliably on hard-to-supervise research tasks, including identifying flaws in research proposals and evaluating whether a proposed experiment supports its intended claim.

item.title: Uncertainty-Guided Latent Diagnostic Trajectory Learning for Sequential Clinical Diagnosis
item.description: Clinical diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under uncertainty. However, most Large Language Model (LLM) based diagnostic systems assume fully observed patient information and therefore do not explicitly model how clinical evidence should be sequentially acquired over time.

item.title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
item.description: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments.

item.title: MERA: A Mid-Circuit-Measurement Error-Aware Compilation Framework for Quantum Circuits
item.description: Mid-circuit measurement (MCM) enables qubit reuse and dynamic control in quantum processors, underpinning resource-efficient algorithms and quantum error correction. However, MCM introduces non-negligible errors, including measurement-induced crosstalk, idling-qubit decoherence, and reset infidelity.

item.title: Spatial Heuristic Strategy based Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Online 3D Bin Packing
item.description: Traditional heuristic methods have accumulated mature experience in core objectives, such as space utilization and layout compactness of 3D bin packing, relying on artificially designed rule-based logic. However, they exhibit obvious limitations in generalization ability and adaptability to dynamic scenarios.

item.title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
item.description: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records.

item.title: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
item.description: Behavior cloning for robotic manipulation is highly sensitive to the coverage of its training data, yet collecting diverse successful demonstrations remains costly. We study reinforcement learning (RL) not as a deployable controller, but as a data generator for downstream visuomotor imitation learning.
